# Seedance 2.0 API

> Generate videos from text, frames or image, video and audio references.

Generate videos from text, frames or image, video and audio references.

## Workflows

| Workflow | Endpoint |
| - | - |
| [Text to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2/text-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.0/text-to-video` |
| [Image to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2/image-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.0/image-to-video` |
| [Reference to video](https://docs.higgsfield.ai/docs/models/seedance-2/reference-to-video.md) | `POST /bytedance/seedance-2.0/reference-to-video` |
